title: Series (market contract 1.0)
description: One line of records.jsonl: one statistic a regulator publishes, over time, with every observation the connector has read.

observations.description: One per period, oldest first: the value as the source last gave it.

files.description: The source's answers the observations were read from, as received.

source_fields.description: What the source says of the series, unchanged: its names and keys as given.

source_id.description: The series' key as the source gives it: the table, the measure and each member's key.

url.description: The page that shows the series, when known.

dataset.description: {issuer}:{source}:{table}: the source's table the series is read from, e.g. ojk:portal:bu_syariah_posisikeuangan.

industry.description: The industry as the source names it, e.g. Bank Umum Syariah; null for a macro series, which belongs to none.

group.description: The source's group of information, e.g. Informasi Keuangan Utama; "" when it has none.

metric.description: The table's name as the source gives it, e.g. Laporan Posisi Keuangan.

measure.description: What is counted, e.g. Posisi Keuangan or Jumlah Rekening.

dimensions.description: Which slice of the table this series is: one member per dimension, in the source's order.

frequency.description: How often the series is observed; its periods take the matching form.

unit.description: The unit as the source states it, e.g. Miliar Rp or Persen; null when it states none. Never inferred.

name.description: The dimension, e.g. Akun or DATI1.

key.description: The member's key, stable across periods, e.g. 110001010100.

label.description: The member's name as shown, e.g. 003. 1. Kas dan Setara Kas.

period.description: A month (YYYY-MM), a quarter (YYYY-Qn), a half-year (YYYY-Sn) or a year (YYYY), by the series' frequency.

value.description: As the source gives it, never rescaled.

file.description: The answer the value was read from.

provisional.description: The source marks the period provisional, e.g. SEKI's Aug* or Q2**.

edition.description: When the source last updated the data the answer holds.
